title: Continue Learning Experience & Proactive Guidance System
description: The Continue Learning System becomes the primary entry point into EthioBio. Instead of asking 'What do you want to learn today?', EthioBio proactively guides students toward their highest-value learning actions by converting educational intelligence into a structured daily learning feed.

userStories.title: Domain models: ContinueLearningFeed, LearningCard, FeedSummary
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Pydantic models for ContinueLearningFeed (with sections: primary_action, recovery_actions, review_actions, quiz_opportunities, tutor_actions, summary), LearningCard (wrapping a recommendation with estimated_minutes and xp_reward), and FeedSummary (estimated_minutes, xp_available), so that the feed has a typed contract.
acceptanceCriteria: ContinueLearningFeed has fields: user_id, generated_at, primary_action (optional), sections dict (str -> list[LearningCard]), summary (FeedSummary)
LearningCard has fields: id, title, description, action_type, priority_score, estimated_minutes (int), xp_reward (int | None), metadata (dict)
FeedSummary has fields: estimated_minutes (int), xp_available (int)
All models are Pydantic BaseModel classes
All models live in src/core/learning_intelligence/models/continue_learning.py
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: ContinueLearningService: feed assembly logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ContinueLearningService that calls RecommendationEngine.get_recommendations(), groups recommendations by action_type into sections, picks the highest-priority one as primary_action, decorates each with estimated_minutes and xp_reward, handles empty state (quiz-start prompt + ask-tutor fallback), and returns a ContinueLearningFeed.
acceptanceCriteria: ContinueLearningService.get_feed(user_id) returns ContinueLearningFeed
Calls RecommendationEngine.get_recommendations(snapshot) internally
Groups by action_type into sections: recovery_actions, review_actions, quiz_opportunities, tutor_actions
Primary action is the single highest-priority recommendation across all groups
Empty state fallback: when no recommendations, primary_action is 'Start with a quiz' LearningCard + quiz section has 'Ask Tutor' card
estimated_minutes from ACTIVITY_DURATION_LOOKUP dict keyed by action_type
xp_reward sourced from XP_SOURCES in src/api/gamification.py by activity type
FeedSummary computed as sum of estimated_minutes and xp_reward across all cards
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Continue Learning API endpoint and router
userStories.description: As a developer, I want GET /intelligence/continue-learning/{user_id} that returns a ContinueLearningFeed, registered in the app, with a next.config.js rewrite so the dashboard can reach it.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /intelligence/continue-learning/{user_id} returns ContinueLearningFeed JSON
Response has primary_action, sections (recovery_actions, review_actions, quiz_opportunities, tutor_actions), and summary
Router lives at src/api/intelligence/continue_learning_router.py, uses existing dependency injection pattern
Router is imported and app.include_router'd in src/main.py
/intelligence/:path* rewrite added to dashboard/next.config.js
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: ContinueLearningFeed React component on student detail page
userStories.description: As a student, I want to see a Continue Learning section at the top of my student dashboard that shows my primary action and categorized recommendations, so I know what to do next.
acceptanceCriteria: ContinueLearningFeed component fetches from /intelligence/continue-learning/{userId}
Renders primary action card prominently with title, description, estimated time, XP reward
Renders section cards grouped by type (recovery, review, quiz, tutor)
Each card links to the appropriate activity (quiz page, tutor, recovery page)
Empty state shows 'Start with a quiz' prompt with link to quiz generator
Component placed in dashboard/src/components/learning/ContinueLearningFeed.tsx
Imported and rendered in dashboard/src/app/students/[id]/page.tsx sidebar above GamificationProfile
Loading skeleton shown during fetch
Error state gracefully handled
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: Browser verification not performed: Playwright Chrome not available in environment. Manual verification needed.

userStories.title: Telegram proactive reminder script
userStories.description: As a student, I want daily Telegram reminders about my due reviews and recovery tasks, so I stay on track without opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/send_proactive_reminders.py exists following send_digests.py pattern
Script queries SpacedRepetitionSchedule for due reviews per user
Script queries RecoveryPlan for active plans with pending tasks
Script uses existing bot.send_message to push reminder to each user
Users without telegram_id are skipped gracefully
Message format: 'You have X reviews due today.' + recovery progress if applicable
Script is idempotent and safe to run multiple times
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
